verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Ollama running GGUF-style quantization levels (e.g., q4_K_M, generic 'int4') as part of its own model format; there is no mention anywhere in the pack of support for importing FP8, GPTQ, or AWQ quantized model files, which are distinct formats from other ecosystems (e.g., vLLM/HuggingFace).
